Adelante Capital Management Has Cut Holding in Kilroy Realty (KRC) by $603,914; Facebook (FB) Share Value Declined While Pathstone Family Office Has Raised by $1.35 Million Its Position
May 28, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Adelante Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Kilroy Realty (KRC) by 0.92% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Adelante Capital Management Llc sold 8,161 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.88% with the market. The hedge fund held 883,369 shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $65.94M, down from 891,530 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Adelante Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Kilroy Realty for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $7.54 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.19% or $0.14 during the last trading session, reaching $74.74. About 429,494 shares traded. Kilroy Realty Corporation (NYSE:KRC) has declined 1.46% since May 28, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 13.01% the S&P500.
Pathstone Family Office Llc increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 2212.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pathstone Family Office Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $535.28 billion market cap company.
